prepareInstallation.description: The information required for the installation of build 1.

inputs.name: executor
inputs.description: The executor that inbound cross-chain payloads run on. Pass address(0) to have the setup deploy a dedicated Executor owned by the plugin. Pass the DAO itself to keep execution on the DAO (the setup will grant EXECUTE_PERMISSION on the DAO to the plugin). Any other contract is taken as-is: the DAO must separately authorize the plugin to call `execute` on it, or the receive path cannot execute.

inputs.name: guardian
inputs.description: An address granted PAUSE_PERMISSION only, so it can freeze the message paths (forward / receive / retry) but not reopen them. Pass address(0) for none.

inputs.name: minFailedMessageGas
inputs.description: Gas the controller withholds so a failed inbound message can always be recorded as Delivered and stay retryable/cancellable. 45000 is a good default; 0 disables the reserve.

prepareUninstallation.description: No input is required for the uninstallation.
